# proxmox_acme_account (Resource)

Registers an ACME account with a certificate authority through `/cluster/acme/account`. The account is the prerequisite for ACME certificate orders on nodes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_acme_account" "le" {
  name    = "letsencrypt"
  contact = var.acme_contact_email
  tos_url = "https://letsencrypt.org/documents/LE-SA-v1.5-February-24-2025.pdf"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `contact` (String) Contact address, usually `mailto:admin@example.com`.
- `name` (String) Account name. Changes require replacement.

### Optional

- `directory` (String) ACME directory URL. Proxmox defaults to Let's Encrypt production.
- `eab_hmac_key` (String, Sensitive) External account binding HMAC key (base64url).
- `eab_kid` (String) External account binding key id, for CAs that require it.
- `tos_url` (String) Override the terms-of-service URL if the CA does not advertise one.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Account name.
- `location` (String) Account URL reported by the CA.
